objective: Keep the entry universe broad and test whether state persistence, hysteresis, broker-day reset, broker-week agreement, or one-time stop rearm improves the day-open state mechanism without post-result filtering.

data_contract.entry_price: M1 open whose timestamp exactly equals decision timestamp

common_state_definition.broker_day_open: open of the closed/ongoing D1 bar for the H4 decision's broker date, known from the D1 bar open
common_state_definition.base_raw_state: LONG when closed H4 close > broker-day open, SHORT when closed H4 close < broker-day open, unchanged/neutral on equality
common_state_definition.stop_atr: latest fully closed M15 ATR14 at the H4 decision timestamp
common_state_definition.normal_exit: exact M1 open at the H4 decision where the effective desired state flips
common_state_definition.gap_stop: if M1 opens through stop, exit at that M1 open
common_state_definition.holding_across_missing_m1: position continues; artificial bars are prohibited

families.rule: Use base raw state directly. Enter on the first non-neutral state. Hold through repeated same-state H4 decisions. After stop, remain flat until the raw state flips.

An effective state is created or flipped only after two consecutive closed H4 decisions show the same non-neutral raw state. A contrary or neutral decision resets the pending confirmation count. After stop, remain flat until a confirmed opposite effective-state flip.

LONG threshold is day_open + 0.25 times latest fully closed H4 ATR14; SHORT threshold is day_open - 0.25 times H4 ATR14. Between thresholds, retain the existing effective state and position; if no effective state exists, remain flat. After stop, remain flat until an effective-state flip.

Use base raw state. State flips operate normally. At the first eligible closed H4 decision of each new broker date, permit a fresh entry in the current raw state even if it matches the previous day's state. After stop, remain flat until either a raw-state flip or the first eligible H4 decision of the next broker date. Maximum one day-reset entry per broker date.

Broker week starts Monday 00:00 server time. Week open is the D1 open of that Monday. Effective LONG requires H4 close above both broker-day open and broker-week open; effective SHORT requires close below both. When the two references disagree, retain an existing effective state/position, or remain flat if none. After stop, remain flat until an effective-state flip.

Use base raw state. After the first stop in a state episode, allow exactly one re-entry at the next valid closed H4 decision if the raw state remains unchanged. A second stop leaves the strategy flat until the raw state flips. Flip resets the one-rearm allowance.

execution_order: All 12 configurations are generated and evaluated in one frozen run.

formal_gate.family_pass: Both stop translations must be nonnegative support and at least one must pass every full gate.

promotion_boundary: No fresh Shadow, live-ready state, final signal, Discord delivery, or MT5 order is authorized solely by this retrospective cycle.
